did.unittitle: John A. Hartford Foundation records, Office Files, Program Files, and Administrative records (2023 Accessions)

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 0 - Intial Access.
Records remain in original housing. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Arranged in series by record type.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: Records transferred to RAC by the John A. Hartford Foundation in two accessions in 2023.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection is comprised of a selection of administrative records, grant and program files, Board of Trustees records, consultant files, Directors files, and publications.
